'''Kharrus' staff''' was a staff which [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] used habitually during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was about one meter tall and its end had a large gold medallion. After Kharrus was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] placed this staff on the Senator's grave.

==Behind the scenes==
The top of Kharrus' staff resembles the headpiece of the Staff of Ra from the first [[Indiana Jones]] movie, [[Wikipedia:Raiders of the Lost Ark|''Raiders of the Lost Ark'']] ([[1981]]), which was also produced by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="The Gungan General Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode012.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Gungan General}}</ref> The [[Ryloth Ark|Ark of the Covenant]] made an appearance as well, in the episode "[[Liberty on Ryloth]]."<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode021.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>
